title: Sequence-slot timing ledger with KV-hit adjustment and synthetic-span stitching
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a new "sequence-slot" timing ledger to attribute latency and cost at a per-sequence-position granularity, incorporate KV cache hit/miss adjustments, and stitch synthetic spans so downstream trace collectors can reconstruct per-slot timings without exploding trace cardinality.
background: Current token-attribution telemetry records coarse per-request and per-stage timings which hide variability across sequence positions (prompt vs generation vs post-processing) and overcharges cost for cache-friendly workloads. Previous attempts (lightweight per-token probes) increased telemetry volume and stressed the metrics pipeline. We need an approach that preserves fine-grained attribution while bounding cardinality and storage cost.
proposal: Introduce an in-memory "sequence-slot ledger" written as a compact event blob per request. Each ledger contains a small fixed-format array of slot records (slot index, micro-latency delta, kv_hit_flag, op_type). At request completion we emit: (1) a tracing span that references the ledger blob id and high-level timings, (2) a compressed metrics record with aggregated slot buckets (head/middle/tail + kv-hit counters), and (3) an optional full ledger sample for 0.1% of requests to the tracing pipeline. To reconcile costs we apply a KV-hit adjustment factor when deriving per-slot cost in the billing pipeline and expose both adjusted and raw per-slot latencies in dashboards.
design_decisions: Use compact binary ledger (protobuf varint + RLE for repeated op_types) to keep per-request payload < 1KB in 99th percentile
Emit only summary histograms for metrics pipeline; full ledgers only on sampling to avoid high cardinality
Stitching approach: create a synthetic parent span named 'seq-ledger' with metadata pointing to ledger_id; sampled full ledgers store slot-level span annotations for quick developer debugging
KV-hit accounting: record boolean hit per slot and apply regression-tested cost multipliers in post-processing instead of doing expensive runtime cost calculations
Backwards compatibility: fall back to existing per-request timing when ledger not present; consumers must tolerate missing per-slot breakdowns
tasks: Schema: define protobuf schema for sequence-slot ledger and compact encoding rules
Runtime: add lightweight ledger recorder in serving runtime hot path with minimal allocations
Tracing: implement synthetic 'seq-ledger' parent span emission and link to blob store key
Metrics: add aggregated slot-bucket exporter (head/mid/tail) and kv-hit counters to metrics pipeline
Sampling: add probabilistic sampler to emit full ledgers to the tracing collector (default 0.1%)
Pipeline: update trace/metrics parsers in observability to decode compact ledgers and produce per-slot rollups
Billing: add KV-hit adjustment step to per-request cost derivation job and add flags for adjusted vs raw cost
Dashboards: new token-level latency panel with adjustable kv-hit toggle and sample-driven detail view
E2E tests: microbenchmarks to ensure <1% p99 latency overhead, pipeline load tests for metrics volume
Docs: write developer guide and runbook for investigating anomalies with sampled ledgers
acceptance_criteria: Unit + integration tests for ledger encoding/decoding
Runtime instrumentation added and validated on staging with <1% end-to-end p99 latency regression
Metrics pipeline shows aggregated slot buckets at stable ingest rate; no high-cardinality explosion
Tracing collector receives full ledgers at configured sample rate and synthetic spans link to them
Billing job produces per-slot adjusted cost and matches expected cost on 5 representative workloads
New dashboard panels render and provide kv-hit filtered views; PM sign-off on interpretability
Runbook entry and post-deploy smoke checks documented
